title: Restore the seconds part of seconds_to_label
text:
duration.py has seconds_to_label(seconds). For durations of a minute or
more it drops the remaining seconds, so 90 renders as "1m" instead of
"1m 30s".

Make it return "<m>m <s>s" for durations of a minute or more:
90 -> "1m 30s", 120 -> "2m 0s", 3661 -> "61m 1s". Keep the sub-minute
behaviour exactly as it is (0 -> "0s", 45 -> "45s", negatives -> "0s").
